- [**Another World Suite: a WebAssembly engine and debugger**](https://github.com/malandrin/another-world-suite) - Another World Suite implements the Another World game engine in Rust and compiles it to WebAssembly for browser use. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/another-world-suite-case/)</sub>

- [**Azel: reverse engineering Panzer Dragoon Saga into native C++**](https://github.com/yaz0r/Azel) - Reconstructs the Sega Saturn RPG Panzer Dragoon Saga as native C++, rewriting the game’s SH-2 routines for its kernel, field, town, battle, menu and audio systems. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/azel-panzer-dragoon-saga-reimplementation-case/)</sub>
- [**BaK GL: rebuilding Betrayal at Krondor mechanics**](https://github.com/xavieran/BaKGL) - BaKGL reimplements Betrayal at Krondor in a C++ and OpenGL engine built around original game data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bakgl-case/)</sub>

- [**Ballanced: reimplementing the Ballance runtime**](https://github.com/doyaGu/Ballanced) - Ballanced is a source-level reimplementation of the Ballance runtime. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ballanced/)</sub>
